data.title: ASU a partner in new national Foundry School announced by White House
data.description: A national initiative to train the next wave of workers in American manufacturing has chosen Arizona State University as one of its flagship institutions. This initiative, led by the U.S. Department of State, aims to strengthen the workforce in this critical sector. ASU is one of eight universities selected for this program, highlighting its dedication to preparing skilled professionals for the industry. The initiative, known as The Foundry School, launched on September 4, 2026. This selection underscores ASU's commitment to innovative education and its role in shaping the future workforce.

data.title: Potomac Edison Proposes Rate Adjustment to Support Electric System Reliability
data.description: Potomac Edison, a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp., has proposed a rate adjustment in Maryland on September 4, 2026. Despite this adjustment, the residential electric rates are expected to remain the most competitive among Maryland investor-owned utilities. Potomac Edison aims to continue its commitment to providing affordable electricity to its customers.

data.title: Strong US job growth in August surprises markets, pushes Bitcoin below $80K amid speculation of Federal Reserve rate cut.
data.description: In August, the US economy saw a significant increase in job creation, surpassing expectations. This development led to a drop in the value of Bitcoin as traders adjusted their predictions for a potential interest rate cut by the Federal Reserve later this month. The strong job growth numbers influenced market sentiment and potentially altered the likelihood of Fed actions in the near future.
